subject: planner: trigger stats load on a column in determinate mode to make sure analyze row count is available (#51435)
summary: Reviewed this commit vs its first parent. The change extends stats-usage collection to always track visited physical table IDs, and in the planner stats-load optimization it triggers an extra column stats load in OptObjectiveDeterminate when no pushed-down predicates exist, so GetAnalyzeRowCount can be obtained (sync via StatsLoadSyncWait>0; otherwise async via statistics.HistogramNeededItems). No remaining Blocker/High issues found in correctness, SQL semantics, data consistency, compatibility, or concurrency within the touched planner/statistics code paths. Later upstream history significantly refactors/moves this logic (e.g. 0ed511a84b, 927f3c61ee).
